title: review-queue reviewers.json config
description: Schema for tools/review-queue/reviewers.json — the per-deploy reviewer roster + runtime metadata. Source of truth for the reviewer slugs known to combine.py / request.py / shared helpers. The reviewer.schema.json + request.schema.json + combined.schema.json `reviewer` / `<slug>_response` surfaces must be kept in sync manually when a reviewer is added (per spec 043 R1 HIGH #5 + 056 AC2). The `invoke_command` field is REQUIRED for mode:headless entries (056 AC5 part 1) and MAY be omitted for mode:ide entries (Cursor's IDE-mode reviewer has no headless wrapper to launch).

invoke_command.description: Headless-only. Template string used by tools/review-queue/_run_reviewer.sh to launch the per-vendor CLI inside the per-tick worktree. The `{{PROMPT}}` token is mandatory (substituted with the resolved prompt path); the `{{WT}}` token is optional (substituted with the worktree absolute path). Substitution is shell-safe via shlex.quote → bash -c per 056 AC5 part 3 Option A.
